items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: He brought some Michigan musicians with him and he hired me on bass... Clarence Chance (phonetic) Johnson, Eli Rice, Grant Moore, Zach White

ctx.x: And I took that job with walkathon. He brought some Michigan musicians with him and he hired me on bass, you know. And that was bangin' twenty-five a week, you know, which--
Clarence Chance (phonetic) Johnson, Eli Rice, Grant Moore, Zach White, he went out to the West Coast?
No. This guy's just died a few years ago. You got anything of Kansas City bands?
